shots.headline: Type Vietnamese in every app
shots.sub: Telex or VNI on the keyboard you already use, with no input method to install.

callout.title: Lumi Gõ tiếng Việt
callout.label: Right there in the menu bar
callout.body: Click the V for everything here. Right-click it, or press fn ⇧, to switch to English at once.

shots.headline: Each app keeps its own
shots.sub: Switch to English in Terminal once, and it stays English there.

callout.title: Lumi Gõ tiếng Việt
callout.label: Remembered for each app
callout.body: The other apps you type English in, at a glance under Per app.

shots.headline: Type it your way
shots.sub: Modern tone marks, Escape to take a word back, English kept as typed.

callout.title: Lumi Gõ tiếng Việt
callout.label: Escape gives back the keys
callout.body: Press esc right after a word to get back what you typed: tiếng → tieengs.

shots.headline: Your keys stay on this Mac
shots.sub: No network and nothing kept: Lumi lets it change only the word you are typing.

callout.title: Lumi Gõ tiếng Việt
callout.label: In Vietnamese or English
callout.body: Every page of it reads in Tiếng Việt or English — you choose.
